units.source_text: 正如前面所说，先生始终是平静而沉稳的，

en.t: As I said before, Sensei was always quiet and composed,

units.source_text: 但偶尔会有一缕奇妙的阴云掠过他的脸，

en.t: but at times a strange shadow would pass across his face,

units.source_text: 就像鸟儿飞过窗外时的黑影，倏忽而过。

en.t: like the dark shadow of a bird flying past the window, it vanished in an instant.

units.source_text: 我第一次发现先生眉宇间那瞬间出现的阴云，是那次在杂司谷墓地，自己冷不防喊他的时候。

en.t: The first time I noticed that momentary shadow between Sensei's brows was when I unexpectedly called out to him in the cemetery at Zoshigaya.

units.source_text: 那一瞬间先生的异样表情，曾使我心脏里顺畅流动的血液都变得迟缓了。

en.t: At that instant, Sensei's strange expression slowed even the blood that had been flowing smoothly through my heart.

units.source_text: 但那只是暂时的停滞，

en.t: But that was only a temporary pause,

units.source_text: 不到五分钟，我的心脏就恢复了正常的跳动，

en.t: and in less than five minutes my heart had recovered its normal beat,

units.source_text: 我也就忘记了这转瞬即逝的黯淡云影。

en.t: and I forgot that fleeting dark cloud-shadow.

units.source_text: 使我突然又想起这件事，是十月小阳春过后不久的一天晚上。

en.t: What suddenly made me remember it again was an evening not long after the mild late-autumn days of October had passed.

units.source_text: 我和先生聊天时，眼前突然浮现出先生指给我看的那棵大银杏树。

en.t: As I was talking with Sensei, the great ginkgo tree he had pointed out to me suddenly rose before my eyes.

units.source_text: 我一估算，离先生每月固定去扫墓的日子还有三天，

en.t: When I counted it out, there were three days until Sensei's regular monthly visit to the grave,

units.source_text: 那天下午我正好没课，有时间出来，

en.t: and that afternoon I happened to have no classes and had time to go out,

units.source_text: 就对先生说：“先生，杂司谷的银杏树叶已经落光了吧？”

en.t: so I said to Sensei, "Sensei, have the ginkgo leaves at Zoshigaya all fallen by now?"

units.source_text: “应该还没有变秃吧。”

en.t: "They probably have not gone completely bare yet."

units.source_text: 先生这样回答时，盯着我的脸，好半天没有移开目光。

en.t: As Sensei answered, he stared at my face and did not look away for quite a while.

units.source_text: 我马上说：

en.t: I immediately said:

units.source_text: “下次您去扫墓的时候，我可以跟您一起去吗？

en.t: "The next time you go to visit the grave, may I go with you?

units.source_text: 我想和您一起去那里散散步。”

en.t: I would like to walk around there with you."

units.source_text: “我是去扫墓，不是去散步的。”

en.t: "I am going to visit a grave, not to take a walk."

units.source_text: “顺便散散步，不是挺好吗？”

en.t: "Wouldn't it be nice to take a walk while you are there?"
